scientific_integrity: Analytic local Jacobian proof, exact inverse algebra, independent plane-basis numerical checks and low-discrepancy numerical diagnostics; no independent review or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly triaxial ellipsoids, exactly central Haar-uniform plane normals; no uniform asymptotic across repeated-axis limits, no finite-sample noise guarantees, no full-law nonuniqueness conclusion. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Quartic near-circular section tails and a sharp two-statistic ambiguity for triaxial ellipsoids
